subject: user_apps configuration does not work for all users

messages.author: 6179e076e87780ae
messages.subject: user_apps configuration does not work for all users
parts:
I have been struggling with the shiny-server.conf file for several days now and not making progress. I have installed Shiny Server on Archlinux and I can bring it up successfully as root and works fine with the default config. I would like to set it up for users to host apps locally in their home directory. So I have the following shiny-server.conf file:

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"
run_as shiny;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
 listen 3838;

 location /userApps {
   user_apps;  
   directory_index on;
 }
}

I have a testapp in /srv/shiny-server. When I start the server, I can access both the sample-apps and my testapp, being served from /srv/shiny-server, with the url http://localhost:3838/ or http://localhost:3838/testapp
I have the same apps in my local "/home/john/ShinyApps" directory. However, when I access the url "http://localhost:3838/userApps/john/testapp" or "http://localhost:3838/userApps/john/sample-apps/" I get a "Page not found" error. I have tried various combinations, including the user_dirs directive, but I have not been able to successfully access apps from local directory. I have no idea what I am doing wrong. Can someone please point me in the right direction or provide an alternate way of running apps from home directory?

Thanks.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: user_apps configuration does not work for all users
parts:
Milind,

I just used your snippet of configuration on my system, and it works fine. I am using Shiny Server v1.3.0.403. What is your version?

Make sure this is not a case-sensitivity issue (the case should match between your configuration, directory structure, and the URL you are using).
Also, can you paste your whole shiny-server.conf file? I wonder if there is anything else that conflicts with this setting.

Fereshteh
